tree.heading: In general
tree.text: The Attorney General may make grants to State, Indian tribal, or local prosecutors for the purpose of supporting the creation or expansion of community-based justice programs.

tree.heading: Consultation
tree.text: The Attorney General may consult with the Ounce of Prevention Council in making grants under subsection (a).

notes.text: Codification Section was formerly classified to section 13861 of Title 42, The Public Health and Welfare, prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.
